text:
leo: heads-up — noisy mixed-dim embeddings from a customer tripped our tenant-level soft quota yesterday and the quota UI was misleading.
priya: what happened exactly?
leo: they sent ~700 items mixed 256/512/1024, gzip'd. runtime accepted then queueing hit tenant softcap and we started shedding. Console showed "throttled" but no breakdown of why (units vs bytes vs dims). Customer confused.
hana: we should surface a heatmap in Console that correlates recent embed-units, max-dim, and compressed_bytes so customers see the cause not just the symptom. Also show last reject reason and suggested chunk size.
console-pm: Agree — product wants an inline quota explorer: time-series for units consumed, recent soft-rejects, and a one-click "simulate paste" that runs the preflight estimator and shows expected credits/route.
leo: Runtime view: we need rate-limiter to publish `X-Embed-Quota-Decision` header on rejects with structured value like `units:480;max_dim:1024;reason:soft_cap`. SDKs can parse that and surface helpful error messages instead of a raw 429.
priya: +1. We also need to reduce runtime latency impact: when a mixed-dim batch is large and likely to be shed, prefer fast-reject (with hint) rather than holding it in batching windows. That avoids blocking other tenants.
hana: UX detail: heatmap should be bucketed (units_buckets: [0-100,100-500,500+]) and clickable to list sample API keys affected. Avoid per-key cardinality explosion.
console-pm: We'll add an explanatory tooltip: "Embed units estimate = sum(dim_weight * count) scaled by payload compression. High-dimension items cost more. Try client-side chunking or streaming." Link to SDK snippet.
telemetry-bot: schema proposal: embeds.quota_event.v1 (fields: tenant_id_bucket, units_bucket, max_dim_bucket, reject_reason, suggested_chunk_bucket, gzip_used_bool).
leo: also add a small UI banner when a tenant crosses 80% of monthly units and recommend quota top-up or auto-chunk.
priya: For runtime, change behavior: metrics-only for 1w (emit headers + telemetry), then fast-reject on hits returning 429 with `X-Embed-Suggest-Chunks` and body `{"error":"quota_exceeded","estimated_units":"480","suggested_chunk":"100","help":"https://docs.redwood/embeds/quota"}`. Canary to 2% tenants first so we watch retry churn.
hana: Console: implement the heatmap tile + "simulate paste" tool. Also add a "preview cost" API that accepts dims + compressed_size and returns units and route impact. Should be the same estimator as runtime.
console-pm: I'll draft the Console layout and copy for the banner and heatmap. We'll include an "auto-chunk on upload" toggle in the beta.
telemetry-bot: add dashboard request: quota heatmap (per-tenant bucket), recent soft_reject_rate, preflight->retry_success funnel. Keep labels small.
rate-limiter-bot: scheduled deploy: embeds-quota-hint v0.1 -> staging (sha: cafe123).
leo: SDK change: parse `X-Embed-Quota-Decision` and `X-Embed-Suggest-Chunks` and optionally auto-split when enabled. Add header `X-Embed-Client-AutoSplit:true` on retries for telemetry.
priya: decide on header format: prefer simple semicolon-delimited to avoid JSON in headers. Example: `units=480;max_dim=1024;reason=soft_cap;suggest=100`.
hana: rollout plan sounds good. Also add a user-friendly email trigger for tenants with repeated soft-rejects linking to the Console quota explorer.
console-pm: will add an opt-in toggle in billing settings: "Enable auto-chunk recommendation" so account admins can allow SDK autop-splitting for their team keys.
leo: test plan: e2e with gzip/no-gzip framing, mixed dims, and simulate many small items vs few large items to ensure the estimator is sane.
telemetry-bot: registered new metric names and example buckets.
priya: tagging @eng-oncall to watch canary for any SLO regressions.
leo: I'll open runtime PR ING-4201 for quota headers + fast-reject. Console PM will open DOC ticket for heatmap and sample code.
hana: nice, let's keep the estimator deterministic and documentable so third-party clients can mimic it if needed.
rate-limiter-bot: deploy completed to staging (sha: cafe123) — monitoring started.
